# App Landing Pages Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add five app landing pages (`/jlpt-vocab-master/`, `/easyvocab/`, `/provocab/`, `/tabata-timer/`, `/ko/easyvocab/`) to prseo7.github.io, generated by one Jekyll layout from front matter, and link them from the homepage cards.

**Architecture:** GitHub Pages already runs Jekyll (primer theme, no `_config.yml`). A custom `_layouts/app.html` renders every section, the head tags, and the `SoftwareApplication`/`FAQPage`/`BreadcrumbList` JSON-LD from each page's front matter, so visible text and structured data cannot drift. GA4 consent and the cookie banner move from `index.html` into `_includes/` so every page shares one copy; `index.html` gets `layout: null` front matter so it stays a standalone page. A stdlib Python checker (`_tools/check-site.py`) validates the built site.

**Tech Stack:** Jekyll 3.x via the `github-pages` gem (local build only, Gemfile in the scratchpad), Liquid, plain HTML/CSS, Python 3 stdlib, ImageMagick 7 + `cwebp`.

**Spec:** `_docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-app-landing-pages-design.md`

**Git:** Sangwon commits and pushes manually. No task in this plan runs `git commit` or `git push`. The "Checkpoint" step at the end of each task is where Sangwon may commit.

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the checker**

Create `_tools/check-site.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Checks a built prseo7.github.io site (Jekyll _site/ directory).

Usage: _tools/check-site.py <site_dir>

App pages: title <= 60 chars, meta description <= 155, canonical, one <h1>,
JSON-LD parses and has MobileApplication + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList, FAQ
count matches the visible FAQ, hreflang pairs are reciprocal, no Font
Awesome, no banned wording. All pages: internal links and images resolve.
Homepage: not wrapped in the primer layout, has the cookie banner, links
to every app page. Exits 1 on any failure.
"""
import json
import re
import sys
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

SITE = "https://prseo7.github.io"
APP_PAGES = ["/jlpt-vocab-master/", "/easyvocab/", "/provocab/", "/tabata-timer/", "/ko/easyvocab/"]
BANNED = [r"native speaker", r"원어민", r"\bpreset", r"\$\d", r"￦\d", r"AdMob", r"LevelPlay"]


class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title, self.meta, self.links, self.refs = "", {}, [], []
        self.jsonld, self.h1, self.faq_items = [], 0, 0
        self._in_title = self._in_jsonld = False
        self._buf = ""

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == "title":
            self._in_title = True
        elif tag == "meta" and a.get("name"):
            self.meta[a["name"]] = a.get("content", "")
        elif tag == "link":
            self.links.append(a)
            if a.get("rel") not in ("canonical", "alternate", "preconnect", "dns-prefetch"):
                self.refs.append(a.get("href"))
        elif tag == "script" and a.get("type") == "application/ld+json":
            self._in_jsonld, self._buf = True, ""
        elif tag == "h1":
            self.h1 += 1
        if tag in ("a",):
            self.refs.append(a.get("href"))
        if tag in ("img", "source", "script"):
            self.refs.append(a.get("src") or (a.get("srcset") or "").split(" ")[0] or None)
        if "faq-item" in (a.get("class") or "").split():
            self.faq_items += 1

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == "title":
            self._in_title = False
        elif tag == "script" and self._in_jsonld:
            self.jsonld.append(self._buf)
            self._in_jsonld = False

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self._in_title:
            self.title += data
        if self._in_jsonld:
            self._buf += data


def parse(path):
    p = Page()
    p.feed(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return p


def resolves(site, page_path, ref):
    if not ref or ref.startswith(("http:", "https:", "mailto:", "#", "data:", "//")):
        return True
    ref = ref.split("#")[0].split("?")[0]
    if not ref:
        return True
    base = site if ref.startswith("/") else page_path.parent
    target = (base / ref.lstrip("/")).resolve()
    return any(c.exists() for c in (target, target / "index.html", target.with_suffix(".html")))


def main(site_dir):
    site = Path(site_dir).resolve()
    errors = []

    def err(where, msg):
        errors.append(f"{where}: {msg}")

    alternates = {}
    for url in APP_PAGES:
        f = site / url.strip("/") / "index.html"
        if not f.exists():
            err(url, "page missing")
            continue
        p = parse(f)
        if not p.title or len(p.title) > 60:
            err(url, f"title length {len(p.title)} (1-60): {p.title!r}")
        desc = p.meta.get("description", "")
        if not desc or len(desc) > 155:
            err(url, f"description length {len(desc)} (1-155)")
        canon = [l.get("href") for l in p.links if l.get("rel") == "canonical"]
        if canon != [SITE + url]:
            err(url, f"canonical {canon}")
        if p.h1 != 1:
            err(url, f"{p.h1} <h1> elements")
        types, faq_count = set(), 0
        for block in p.jsonld:
            try:
                data = json.loads(block)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                err(url, f"JSON-LD does not parse: {e}")
                continue
            for node in data.get("@graph", [data]):
                types.add(node.get("@type"))
                if node.get("@type") == "FAQPage":
                    faq_count = len(node.get("mainEntity", []))
        for t in ("MobileApplication", "FAQPage", "BreadcrumbList"):
            if t not in types:
                err(url, f"JSON-LD missing {t}")
        if faq_count == 0 or faq_count != p.faq_items:
            err(url, f"FAQ JSON-LD {faq_count} vs visible {p.faq_items}")
        alternates[url] = {l.get("hreflang"): l.get("href") for l in p.links if l.get("rel") == "alternate"}
        text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if "font-awesome" in text or "fa-" in text:
            err(url, "Font Awesome reference")
        for pattern in BANNED:
            if re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE):
                err(url, f"banned wording /{pattern}/")

    for url, alts in alternates.items():
        for lang, href in alts.items():
            other = href.replace(SITE, "") if href else ""
            if lang != "x-default" and other in alternates and SITE + url not in alternates[other].values():
                err(url, f"hreflang {lang} -> {href} is not reciprocal")

    home = site / "index.html"
    home_text = home.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "container-lg" in home_text:
        err("/", "wrapped in the primer layout (front matter needs layout: null)")
    if 'id="cookie-consent"' not in home_text or "window.loadAnalytics" not in home_text:
        err("/", "cookie banner or analytics loader missing")
    for url in APP_PAGES[:4]:
        if f'href="{url}"' not in home_text:
            err("/", f"no link to {url}")

    for f in sorted(site.rglob("*.html")):
        if f.name.startswith("google"):
            continue
        for ref in parse(f).refs:
            if not resolves(site, f, ref):
                err(str(f.relative_to(site)), f"broken reference {ref}")

    for e in errors:
        print("FAIL", e)
    print(f"{len(errors)} problem(s)")
    return 1 if errors else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "_site"))
```

### Task 3: Image script — icons and web screenshots

**Files:**
- Create: `_tools/make-app-images.sh`
- Create: `images/apps/<slug>/icon.png`, `icon.webp`, `screenshot-<n>.webp`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the script**

Create `_tools/make-app-images.sh`:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds the web images for the app landing pages under images/apps/<slug>/:
#   icon.png + icon.webp (256x256) from each app repo's 1024px iOS icon, and
#   screenshot-<n>.webp (390px wide) from images/apps/<slug>/raw/*.png, in name order.
# raw/ is git-ignored. Prints each screenshot's size for the page front matter.
# Requires ImageMagick 7 and cwebp. _tools/ is not published by Jekyll.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

APPS=/Users/sangwon/workspace/prseo7
ICON=ios/Runner/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/Icon-App-1024x1024@1x.png

icon() {  # <slug> <app repo>
  local out=images/apps/$1
  mkdir -p "$out"
  magick "$APPS/$2/$ICON" -resize 256x256 -strip -define png:compression-level=9 "$out/icon.png"
  cwebp -quiet -q 90 "$out/icon.png" -o "$out/icon.webp"
  magick identify -format '%f %wx%h %b\n' "$out/icon.png" "$out/icon.webp"
}

screenshots() {  # <slug>
  local out=images/apps/$1 n=0 f
  [ -d "$out/raw" ] || return 0
  rm -f "$out"/screenshot-*.webp
  for f in "$out"/raw/*.png; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=$((n + 1))
    cwebp -quiet -q 82 -resize 390 0 "$f" -o "$out/screenshot-$n.webp"
    magick identify -format "$out/screenshot-$n.webp %wx%h %b\n" "$out/screenshot-$n.webp"
  done
}

icon jlpt-vocab-master jlpt_n3_words
icon easyvocab hello_english
icon provocab pro_vocab
icon tabata-timer tabata_timer
icon easyvocab-ko hello_english   # the Korean page's own image dir

for slug in jlpt-vocab-master easyvocab easyvocab-ko provocab tabata-timer; do
  screenshots "$slug"
done
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `_includes/analytics.html`** (moved from `index.html` lines 63-101; only `page_title` changes)

```html
  <!-- Google Analytics 4, basic Consent Mode: gtag.js is not loaded and nothing is
       sent until the visitor accepts in the cookie banner. Keep /privacy-policy/ in
       sync with what this block collects. Pass the GA page title as the include's title parameter. -->
  <script>
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    function gtag() { dataLayer.push(arguments); }
    gtag('consent', 'default', {
      ad_storage: 'denied',
      ad_user_data: 'denied',
      ad_personalization: 'denied',
      analytics_storage: 'denied'
    });

    window.GA_MEASUREMENT_ID = 'G-G7Y10CF072';
    window.loadAnalytics = function () {
      if (window.analyticsLoaded) return;
      window.analyticsLoaded = true;
      window['ga-disable-' + window.GA_MEASUREMENT_ID] = false;
      gtag('consent', 'update', { analytics_storage: 'granted' });
      // Re-accepting after a withdrawal on the same page: gtag.js is already loaded
      if (window.analyticsScriptAdded) return;
      window.analyticsScriptAdded = true;
      gtag('js', new Date());
      gtag('config', window.GA_MEASUREMENT_ID, {
        page_title: {{ include.title | jsonify }},
        allow_google_signals: false,
        allow_ad_personalization_signals: false
      });
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.async = true;
      s.src = 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=' + window.GA_MEASUREMENT_ID;
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    };

    try {
      if (localStorage.getItem('cookie-consent') === 'accepted') window.loadAnalytics();
    } catch (e) { }
  </script>
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `_includes/cookie-banner.html`**

CSS is `index.html` lines 258-328 verbatim; markup is lines 973-983 with the strings from labels; the script is the "Cookie Consent Management" part of the homepage IIFE (lines 1143-1207) in its own IIFE. It binds to `#cookie-settings` if the page has one.

```html
{%- assign CL = site.data.app_labels[page.lang] | default: site.data.app_labels.en -%}
  <style>
    /* Cookie Consent Banner */
    .cookie-banner {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: rgba(51, 51, 51, 0.95);
      color: white;
      padding: 1rem 0;
      z-index: 10000;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .cookie-banner p {
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .cookie-banner a {
      color: white;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .cookie-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .cookie-btn {
      padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .cookie-btn.accept {
      background: #667eea;
      color: white;
    }

    .cookie-btn.accept:hover {
      background: #5a6fd8;
    }

    .cookie-btn.decline {
      background: transparent;
      color: #ccc;
      border: 1px solid #ccc;
    }

    .cookie-btn.decline:hover {
      background: #ccc;
      color: #333;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .cookie-buttons {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.5rem;
      }

      .cookie-btn {
        width: 100%;
      }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Cookie Consent Banner -->
  <div id="cookie-consent" class="cookie-banner" style="display: none;">
    <div class="container">
      <p>{{ CL.cookie_text }}</p>
      <div class="cookie-buttons">
        <button id="accept-cookies" class="cookie-btn accept">{{ CL.accept }}</button>
        <button id="decline-cookies" class="cookie-btn decline">{{ CL.decline }}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // Cookie Consent Management (needs window.loadAnalytics from _includes/analytics.html)
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      function readConsent() {
        try { return localStorage.getItem('cookie-consent'); } catch (e) { return null; }
      }

      function saveConsent(value) {
        try { localStorage.setItem('cookie-consent', value); } catch (e) { }
      }

      function showCookieConsent(force) {
        const banner = document.getElementById('cookie-consent');
        if (banner && (force || !readConsent())) {
          banner.style.display = 'block';
        }
      }

      // Remove the _ga / _ga_<id> cookies set while consent was granted
      function deleteAnalyticsCookies() {
        const host = window.location.hostname;
        document.cookie.split(';').forEach(function (c) {
          const name = c.split('=')[0].trim();
          if (name === '_ga' || name.indexOf('_ga_') === 0) {
            [host, '.' + host].forEach(function (domain) {
              document.cookie = name + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/; domain=' + domain;
            });
            document.cookie = name + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/';
          }
        });
      }

      function acceptCookies() {
        saveConsent('accepted');
        document.getElementById('cookie-consent').style.display = 'none';
        window.loadAnalytics();
      }

      function declineCookies() {
        saveConsent('declined');
        document.getElementById('cookie-consent').style.display = 'none';

        // Withdrawal after an earlier Accept: stop sending and remove the cookies
        if (window.analyticsLoaded) {
          gtag('consent', 'update', { analytics_storage: 'denied' });
          window['ga-disable-' + window.GA_MEASUREMENT_ID] = true;
          window.analyticsLoaded = false;
        }
        deleteAnalyticsCookies();
      }

      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('accept-cookies');
        const declineBtn = document.getElementById('decline-cookies');
        const settingsLink = document.getElementById('cookie-settings');

        if (acceptBtn) acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', acceptCookies);
        if (declineBtn) declineBtn.addEventListener('click', declineCookies);
        if (settingsLink) settingsLink.addEventListener('click', function () {
          showCookieConsent(true);
        });

        // Show banner if no consent given
        setTimeout(showCookieConsent, 2000);
      });
    })();
  </script>
```

---
---
{%- comment -%}
  App landing page. Every section, head tag and JSON-LD node comes from the page's

  so the visible text and the structured data stay identical.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign L = site.data.app_labels[page.lang] | default: site.data.app_labels.en -%}
{%- assign site_url = "https://prseo7.github.io" -%}
{%- assign canonical = page.url | prepend: site_url -%}
{%- assign img_dir = "/images/apps/" | append: page.slug -%}
{%- assign icon_png = img_dir | append: "/icon.png" -%}
{%- assign downloads = "" | split: "" -%}
{%- if page.stores.ios -%}{%- assign downloads = downloads | push: page.stores.ios -%}{%- endif -%}
{%- if page.stores.android -%}{%- assign downloads = downloads | push: page.stores.android -%}{%- endif -%}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="{{ page.lang }}">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">

  <title>{{ page.title }}</title>
  <meta name="description" content="{{ page.description | escape }}">
  <meta name="robots" content="index, follow">

{%- if page.alternate %}
{%- for alt in page.alternate %}

{%- endfor %}
  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="{{ site_url }}{{ page.alternate.en }}">
{%- endif %}

{%- if page.alternate_name %}

/* App landing pages (_layouts/app.html). Accent and font follow index.html. */
:root {

}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {

}
